verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents running a whole collection as a test suite: the Collection Runner sends multiple requests in order, and 'automatically test multiple requests in your collections' is a stated capability. The Inso CLI automates these tests in CI and returns exit codes that pass or fail the workflow. The pass/fail reporting is evidenced only as CI exit codes, not as a per-test results report. missing for 10: documented per-test pass/fail report output (e.g. a results view or JUnit-style report), and independent or hands-on corroboration of collection test runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an entire collection as an automated test suite with a pass/fail report

citations.quote: Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.
Use the Collection Runner to send multiple requests in a specific order
Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.
It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.
